# 进气与喷管

_Inlets & Nozzles_

进气系统把外部气流引向发动机，喷管则把燃气能量进一步转化为流速。学习时应把总压损失、流量、背压和推进力放在同一条流路中理解。

_The inlet conditions the incoming airflow, while the nozzle converts gas energy into exit velocity. Read pressure loss, mass flow, back pressure and thrust as parts of the same flow path._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 记录进气、发动机与飞机之间的接口条件。

_Record interface conditions between the inlet, engine and aircraft._

- 从质量流量和能量变化理解喷管作用，再阅读堵塞、膨胀等概念。

_Use mass-flow and energy balances to understand nozzle behaviour before studying choking and expansion._

- 区分部件单独性能与装机后的推进系统表现。

_Distinguish isolated component performance from the performance of the installed propulsion system._
